name: ThermaSol Solaris Solar-Powered 2-5 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Recognized by TIME as one of the Best Inventions of 2025, the Solaris Sauna Cabin is a fully off-grid, solar-powered sauna that works wherever the sun shines. A fusion of sustainability and wellness, the Solaris delivers a complete sauna experience with the flexibility of no required power connection. The contemporary design uses Tile Oak cladding on both the exterior and interior for a modern European look that is UV-resistant. Solar panels adorn the roof and one external wall with one day of sunshine needed for a full charge, and the ability to monitor power levels through a mobile app. Enter through the full-length glass door and step into the well-insulated sauna cabin highlighted by an expansive glass window with alder framing. Both pieces of glass are solar tinted to bring in natural light while maintaining privacy during daytime sauna sessions. RGB color therapy LEDs glow from recessed locations throughout the cabin, with the included control able to fully customize users' desired ambiance. Lie back upon brushed alder sauna benches and backrests while the Harvia KIP delivers gentle heat and restorative steam through solar power. Supported by ThermaSol's 1-year warranty, the Solaris outdoor sauna is the first of its kind, offering complete freedom for eco-conscious bathers to experience wellness from anywhere they desire. Features Tile Oak Cladding exterior construction that is modern, durable and UV-resistant. Brushed Alder sauna benches and backrests for a soft, relaxing texture. Solar panels with connected battery pack ensures reliable power during sauna sessions. Solar-tinted glass door and expansive window to enhance natural light while maintaining privacy. Integrated RGB LED color light therapy with control for a custom ambiance. Ideal for private gardens, patios, rooftops, and backyard spaces. Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use. Small dimensions: 60"W (152.4 cm) x 86"D (218.4 cm) x 97"H (246.4 cm) Medium dimensions: 86"W (218.4 cm) x 86"D (218.4 cm) x 97"H (246.4 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia KIP 3kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX170 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3000 Sauna Stones (1 Box) Installation Instructions Specifications Specification Small Medium Recommended capacity 2-3 people 4-5 people Exterior (W × D × H) 60″ × 86″ × 97″ 86″ × 86″ × 97″ Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
